posts.title: Why Chatti Choru Is Served in Clay
posts.excerpt: Rice and curries slow-finished in a wide earthen pot — the way it's served at village tables across Kerala.
posts.body:
Chatti Choru is a combination plate of rice, a variety of curries, and non-veg items, all served in a wide earthen pot.

It's our best seller for a reason: the clay holds the heat, the heat holds the flavour, and the flavour holds the memory.

## Rice and curries, slow-finished in clay

Rice and curries slow-finished in a wide earthen pot — the way it's served at village tables across Kerala.

posts.title: Kizhi Porotta: The Banana-Leaf Reveal
posts.excerpt: Porotta and curry meat steamed and charred inside a banana-leaf parcel — unwrapped fresh at your table.
posts.body:
Kizhi Porotta is cooked porotta stuffed with fried curry meat — usually beef, chicken or veg — wrapped in banana leaf and tied into a bundle. The bundle is steamed, then grilled on a hot skillet with coconut oil, adding the aroma of banana leaf and coconut oil to the filling.

## Unwrapped fresh at your table

Porotta and curry meat steamed and charred inside a banana-leaf parcel — unwrapped fresh at your table.

## Try it at Kayal

Find Kizhi Porotta on our [menu](/menu/#chicken-meat), or [get in touch to book](/contact/).
